{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check premises
premises_check = {
    'valid_segment_new': 'new' in df['customer_segment'].unique(),
    'valid_channel_paid_search': 'paid_search' in df['channel'].unique(),
    'converted_definition': df['converted'].isin([0, 1]).all(),
    'refunded_not_included': 'refunded' in df['status'].unique(),
    'has_new_paid_search': (df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')
}

# Print checks
premises_check"}
